sloka: न परः पापमादत्ते परेषां पापकर्मणाम् ।समयो रक्षितव्यस्तु सन्तश्चारित्रभूषणाः ।। ६.११६.४४ ।।
transliteration: na paraḥ pāpamādatte pareṣāṁ pāpakarmaṇām ।samayo rakṣitavyastu santaścāritrabhūṣaṇāḥ ।। 6.116.44 ।।

translations.english: "By Ravana's order they threatened me so. Now with his death, they will not be threatening me."
